name: cycle_stored_state_values
description: Steps a small index counter through several stored state values and loads the selected one into a state longword. When the index passes its last entry it wraps back, and when the loaded value is nonzero it hands control to the shared routine.

name: select_next_state_from_table
description: Chooses the next of several stored state values using a wrapping index and loads it into the state longword. When the chosen value is zero it advances the index again, and otherwise it calls the shared routine.

name: run_frame_update_loop
description: Runs the per-frame loop, which refreshes a scaled height from the playfield, calls indexed graphics routines through the stored base, and counts frames. When the count condition is met it dispatches to a handler chosen from a counter value.

name: decrement_countdown_and_halve_speed
description: Decrements a remaining-steps counter while it is active, halves a speed value, and sets a redraw flag. It clears a pending state word and then continues into the same frame loop used by its neighbours.

name: set_state_to_minus_one
description: Stores the value minus one in a 16-bit state word and then continues into the shared frame code.

name: setup_audio_sprites_with_cleanup
description: Acquires the audio device and three hardware sprites, printing an error message when either cannot be obtained. On shutdown it aborts pending audio requests, removes the interrupt server and message port, and frees the sprites, memory and libraries it opened.

name: draw_mega_title_with_sprites
description: Draws the title text MEGA with bit-block copies and moves sprites into position. Six other routines call it, so it is a shared drawing routine for the title area.

name: drain_message_port_replies
description: Loops over queued messages on a port, replying to each one until the port is empty. It is called by five routines that also set up palette and screen state through graphics and intuition calls.

name: poll_input_messages_for_flag
description: Waits for the vertical blank, then reads queued messages. It sets a flag when one carries the expected activity bit, records a code byte from another message, replies to each message, and repeats until the flag is set.

name: update_bounce_timer_and_direction
description: Counts down a movement timer and, when it expires, reloads it from a value scaled by a speed setting. It reverses direction when the object reaches the edges of the playfield.

name: forward_graphics_library_call
description: Calls one graphics library entry through the stored graphics base and returns, leaving the register results unchanged.

name: lookup_playfield_cell_at_position
description: Converts an x and y position into a cell index of a grid with 20 cells per row, using a border offset and cell sizes of 15 by 7. It returns the position unchanged when it is outside the grid or the cell is empty, and records position data when the cell holds the special value five.

name: clear_playfield_cell_and_count
description: Looks up the playfield cell under a position and, when it holds an object, clears the cell, decrements a remaining count and redraws the cell with a bit-block copy. Empty cells return the position unchanged.

name: write_word_as_decimal_digits
description: Converts a value to decimal text by dividing by ten thousand and then by successively smaller powers of ten. It writes each digit into the text buffer and stops when the remaining quotient is zero.

name: write_decimal_digits_by_divisor
description: Writes a value as decimal text using a divisor passed in a data register. It divides by that divisor and then by ten at each step, storing digits until the quotient is zero.

name: tally_score_until_target_reached
description: Redraws a row of score markers while the score divided by 20000 is below the stored target, stepping a counter each time. Once the target is reached it prints the Score and Board labels and returns.

name: tally_score_with_status_labels
description: Steps the displayed score upward in a nested loop until it reaches the stored target, redrawing the marker row at each step. When it finishes it prints the Score and Board labels.

name: redraw_occupied_playfield_cell
description: Redraws a playfield cell with a bit-block copy when the position falls exactly on a cell boundary and the cell is occupied. Otherwise it leaves the screen alone and returns the input registers.

name: forward_graphics_call_with_result
description: Calls one graphics library entry through the stored graphics base and returns the two result registers it leaves.

name: draw_sprite_table_entries
description: Walks a table of four-word entries and, for each one, computes a horizontal offset clamped to the screen width from a stored value. It then moves the matching sprite to that position.

name: set_palette_to_offset_black
description: Scales each 12-bit colour table entry by a zero factor, adds a fixed bias, and stores the result in the palette buffer. It then calls a library routine and waits two or four steps depending on two state flags.

name: fade_palette_to_partial_level
description: Scales each 12-bit colour entry by a fixed level of twelve out of fifteen, then stores the result in the palette buffer and calls a library routine. It chooses a wait of two or four steps from two state flags.

name: fade_palette_to_black
description: Scales each 12-bit colour entry by a zero factor and stores the result in the palette buffer. It calls a library routine and waits two or four steps depending on two state flags.

name: fade_palette_to_full_brightness
description: Scales each 12-bit colour entry by the full factor of fifteen, stores the result, and loads the palette with the graphics LoadRGB4 call. It waits for the vertical blank before returning.

name: abort_pending_io_requests
description: Calls the library's AbortIO-style entry repeatedly until it returns zero, so no device requests remain outstanding.

name: wait_for_device_requests
description: Calls the library's WaitIO-style entry repeatedly until it returns zero, blocking until outstanding device requests complete.

name: load_board_or_reset_table
description: Selects a 68-byte entry from a table, clearing every entry when the selector is the reset value. When the entry is not held yet it reads a board file, and if opening fails it asks the player to type a full path.

name: open_dos_library
description: Opens dos.library through the exec library table and stores the returned base for later file calls.

name: open_intuition_library
description: Opens intuition.library through the exec library table and stores the returned base for the window and screen calls.

name: close_stored_library_base
description: Closes the library whose base is held in the global library slot through the exec close call. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: open_graphics_library
description: Opens graphics.library through the exec library table and stores its base for the drawing calls.

name: close_stored_library_base
description: Closes the library whose base is held in the global library slot through the exec close call. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: open_diskfont_library
description: Opens diskfont.library through the exec library table and stores its base in the font slot.

name: close_stored_library_base
description: Closes the library whose base is held in the global library slot through the exec close call. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: open_iff_library_or_fail
description: Opens iff.library and, when the open fails, records an error pointer so the caller can report that the library cannot be found.

name: close_stored_library_base
description: Closes the library whose base is held in the global library slot through the exec close call. It takes no arguments and returns nothing.

name: load_music_for_free_memory
description: Compares the available memory with a set of thresholds to choose a memory budget. When enough memory is free it allocates a buffer and reads the MegaBall.Music file into it.

name: read_scores_file_into_buffer
description: Copies a block of longwords into the scores buffer and then reads the MegaBall.scores file if it opens. It closes the file afterwards.

name: write_scores_file
description: Opens the MegaBall.scores file and writes the score table to it, then closes the file, provided the open succeeded.

name: load_ball_iff_image
description: Loads the BALL2 picture through the iff library. When loading fails it records an error pointer, since the file may be invalid or its colour table unreadable.

name: stub_immediate_return
description: Consists of a single return instruction, so it performs no work.

name: decode_iff_picture_checked
description: Decodes the picture held by the iff library and, when decoding fails, records an error pointer and releases the iff resources. It stops at the first failure.

name: open_custom_screen_or_fail
description: Opens a custom screen through intuition and, when the open fails, records an error pointer for the caller to report.

name: open_window_handle
description: Opens a window through intuition and stores the returned window handle for later drawing calls.

name: open_main_window_or_fail
description: Opens the main window through intuition and, when the open fails, records an error pointer for the caller to report.

name: next_pseudo_random_value
description: Advances a 32-bit pseudo-random state by mixing it with several register values, multiplying and adding a fixed constant. It stores the new state for later calls.

name: call_if_slot_nonzero
description: Calls the shared routine only when a stored slot value is nonzero, and returns the register pair unchanged otherwise.

name: call_if_slot_nonzero
description: Calls the shared routine only when a stored slot value is nonzero, and returns the register pair unchanged otherwise.

name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls one shared routine and returns the value zero to its caller.

name: call_shared_routine_pass_through
description: Calls one shared routine and returns the register pair unchanged.

name: find_next_larger_table_byte
description: Clears four state words and calls the shared routine, then scans a byte table for the next entry larger than the current one. It uses the matching record it locates to set the lookup pointers.

name: scan_table_set_audio_volumes
description: Clears four state words and runs the same table scan as its neighbour. It then writes the four audio channel volume registers from the selected entry and reads the fire-button port.

name: silence_audio_channels_if_active
description: When its active flag is set, it clears the flag, zeroes the four audio channel volumes and clears the DMA control bits for the sound channels.

name: advance_audio_playback_step
description: Advances a sound playback step counter while playback is active. On each step it either reloads the audio channel pointers or resets the counter and restarts playback through a series of channel calls.

name: load_audio_channel_sample_entry
description: Copies a four-byte entry into a channel structure and, when the sample index is nonzero, loads the sample pointer and length from a per-sample table, updating the channel volume field.

name: copy_channel_word_to_output
description: Copies one 16-bit value from the channel record into the location given by a stored pointer.

name: scale_channel_volume
description: Multiplies a stored 16-bit value by a global scale factor, shifts the product right by four bits, and writes the result as the channel volume.

name: compare_channel_value_to_target
description: Masks a 12-bit value from the channel record and stores it. It sets a direction flag when the value is below the target, and clears the target when the two are equal.

name: update_channel_effect_state
description: Reads the effect nibble of a channel record and, when it is nonzero, chooses one of three stored values using a counter modulo three. It writes the chosen value back into the record and reads the fire-button port.

name: stub_infinite_loop_gap
description: Only spins forever, so it is a filler gap in the decoded code rather than a real routine with behaviour.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: A single bad-instruction trap with no real code, so it carries no behaviour.

name: spin_after_task_setup
description: Its decoded body only spins in an infinite loop with no exit. The library calls listed for it (memory allocation, task lookup and list insertion) are not visible in the decoded body.

name: release_node_when_count_expires
description: Decrements a countdown field in a node, and when the count reaches zero with a flag bit set it runs the removal routine. It then frees the node memory through the exec entry.

name: finish_node_or_defer_release
description: When the countdown in a node has reached zero it removes the node, releases its memory and returns a stored result. Otherwise it sets a pending-release flag and returns zero.

name: remove_and_free_node_value
description: Removes the node from its list, frees its memory through the exec entries and returns a value stored in the node.

name: find_list_entry_by_key
description: Walks a list of variable-length records, each with a key word and a size field, and returns the record whose key equals the value passed in. It returns a null pointer when no record matches.

name: find_entry_offset_plus_eight
description: Looks up a list entry with the shared search routine and returns the address eight bytes past the found value.

name: copy_bytes_counted_inclusive
description: Copies bytes from the source to the destination, decrementing a count until it wraps past zero. Because the count is tested after each copy it copies one more byte than the count value.

name: copy_bytes_until_counter_wraps
description: Copies bytes one at a time, decrementing a counter before each copy and stopping when the counter wraps to minus one. It copies exactly the count it was given.

name: decode_run_length_bytes
description: Decodes a run-length stream in which a negative control byte repeats the following byte the given number of times, and a positive control byte copies that many literal bytes to the output.

name: decode_packed_byte_runs
description: Writes a repeated byte run for each control value and then copies literal bytes from the input, continuing until the output count is used up.

name: call_shared_routine_only
description: Calls one shared routine and returns without doing any other work.

name: write_ilbm_picture_file
description: Writes an IFF ILBM picture by emitting a FORM header, an ILBM tag and a 20-byte bitmap header chunk. It then packs the bitplane rows into the output with a run-length loop.

name: write_sized_chunk_with_padding
description: Pads a picture chunk length to a word boundary and writes it through the file library entries, checking each step. It stops early when a write fails.

name: close_file_if_open
description: Closes the open file handle when the open flag is set, and then calls the shared routine.

name: scale_eight_table_terms
description: Multiplies a scale value by an eight-entry table of coefficients and stores the eight results in a local buffer, using 16-bit fixed-point arithmetic.

name: fill_wide_fixed_point_buffer
description: Fills a local buffer with eight fixed-point products built from a shared scale value and table coefficients, then continues the calculation over a wider working buffer.

name: count_run_length_until_limit
description: Counts successive bytes of an input stream while they stay below a limit, adding each run length to a running total. It stops when the input ends or a byte breaks the run.

name: encode_run_with_length_byte
description: Scans input for a run of up to 128 bytes, writes the run length as a single byte, and copies the run to the output. It repeats until the input is exhausted.

name: encode_literal_runs_with_header
description: Copies literal runs of input bytes to the output, writing a length byte before each run and accumulating the total count. It repeats while input remains.

name: count_identical_byte_run
description: Counts how many consecutive input bytes repeat the first byte. It stops at the first difference, at the end of the input, or after 128 bytes.

name: find_task_list_node
description: Looks up the current task identifier and walks a linked list of nodes until one stores the same identifier, returning that node or a null pointer.

name: clear_field_and_return_true
description: Clears a 32-bit field in the record when a condition flag is not set, then returns one.

name: store_nonzero_field_value
description: Stores the input value in a record field when the value is nonzero, and returns zero.

name: compute_position_limit_flags
description: Builds a status word from a record. It sets a high flag when a small type field is below five and the x value is above 384, and sets a second flag when the y value is above 279.

name: read_ilbm_header_fields
description: Checks for an ILBM chunk tag and, when it matches, copies four header words from the input record into a local array before handling the picture data.

name: expand_byte_triples_to_words
description: Converts groups of three input bytes into one 16-bit value by combining their nibbles, writing one word per group until the picture length is covered.

name: find_entry_offset_plus_eight
description: Looks up a list entry with the shared search routine and returns the address eight bytes past the found value.

name: allocate_task_record
description: When the zero condition holds, allocates a record and stores a task identifier in it. It clears the record counter, increments the pending count and clears a flag bit.

name: poll_hardware_status_with_codes
description: Writes a sequence of status codes to a work area while calling a routine that polls the hardware, and treats one specific failure code as an exit. It also touches the DMA control register and the fire-button port.

name: clear_interrupt_request_flag
description: Clears one bit of a control word and writes a fixed value into a global, then returns the input register. It touches the interrupt request register and the fire-button port.

name: wait_blitter_then_enable_interrupts
description: Loops until the blitter busy bit clears, runs a routine, and then writes the interrupt enable register with the enable bit set.

name: call_stored_entry_offset
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored in the global entry table through an indirect call, and then returns.

name: copy_block_and_clear_memory
description: Copies a block of longwords from one table to another, raises a trap, and clears a region of low memory with zeros. It is part of the program startup.

name: copy_startup_block_and_clear
description: Raises a trap, clears a low-memory region with zeros, and copies a block of words to a second area as part of the startup sequence.

name: set_four_bitplane_pointers
description: Waits on the raster position, then stores the start addresses of four bitplanes as high and low word pairs. Each plane starts 8000 bytes after the previous one.

name: start_blitter_copy_request
description: Waits for the blitter to finish, loads its source pointer, clears its modulo and control registers, and starts a blit whose size comes from the width argument.

name: start_fixed_size_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to finish, sets its source pointer, clears the modulo and control registers, and starts a blit of the fixed size 24000.

name: fill_table_from_global_value
description: Copies one global value into each of thirty-three consecutive table entries.

name: swap_and_set_bitplane_pointers
description: Swaps two stored buffer pointers depending on which one is current, waits for the raster position, and writes the four bitplane pointer pairs spaced 8000 bytes apart.

name: wait_for_frame_boundary
description: Waits for the raster position counter to leave the sentinel value and then return to it, which marks one display frame boundary.

name: wait_for_raster_sentinel
description: Loops until the stored raster position reaches the sentinel value, which marks the start of a frame.

name: clear_sixteen_word_table
description: Sets one global word to 255 and clears a block of sixteen words that follows it.

name: copy_sixteen_word_table
description: Copies sixteen consecutive words from a source table into a destination table.

name: combine_four_bitplanes_or
description: Ors four bitplane buffers together row by row into one destination buffer, with the row size taken from the image width and height.

name: copy_header_and_combine_planes
description: Copies the size and position fields from the input record, calls three shared routines, and then ors the bitplane rows together into the destination buffer.

name: shift_bitmap_rows_by_offset
description: Shifts the rows of a bitmap horizontally by the amount needed to align its width to a 16-pixel word boundary, working through each plane's words.

name: unpack_bitplane_bits_to_words
description: Walks a bitplane and shifts out one bit at a time from each source word, rebuilding destination words row by row.

name: queue_blit_request_params
description: Waits for the blitter, stores two parameters and control values in a request record, and returns the two inputs offset by eight thousand each.

name: run_five_routines_if_enabled
description: When the enable global is nonzero it calls five shared routines in sequence, then returns the register pair unchanged.

name: call_shared_routine_only
description: Calls one shared routine and returns without doing any other work.

name: call_shared_routine_only
description: Calls one shared routine and returns without doing any other work.

name: setup_blitter_with_clipping
description: Loads the blitter masks, modulo values and control bits from an image record. It returns minus one when the requested rectangle lies outside the drawable area, and otherwise computes the blit parameters.

name: update_blit_state_and_flush
description: Calls a shared routine and returns minus one on failure. On success it resets a blit state field when a flag is zero, calls six shared routines, and returns zero.

name: store_blit_request_fields
description: Waits until the blitter is free, then stores the source, destination, size and modulo values for the next blit request.

name: update_blit_state_and_flush
description: Calls a shared routine and returns minus one on failure. On success it resets a blit state field when a flag is zero, calls five shared routines, and returns zero.

name: reset_blit_state_and_flush
description: Resets a blit state field when a stored flag is zero, then calls five shared routines and returns zero.

name: link_and_walk_record_list
description: Initializes a list head so it points to itself, then walks the records of the list and calls a shared routine on each one until the end is reached.

name: queue_blit_request_with_mask
description: Waits for the blitter to be free and then stores the source and destination pointers, the width and height values, and the control words for a blit request.

name: clear_interrupts_and_set_cia
description: Clears the interrupt request bits, calls a shared routine, and writes the interrupt enable and CIA control registers to set up the interrupt sources.

name: set_key_state_table_entry
description: Writes zero or 255 into one entry of a 128-byte key state table, selected by a bit of the state word, and then loops with no exit. The interrupt control register is part of the setup it belongs to.

name: store_serial_key_state
description: Reads a keyboard serial value and writes zero or 255 into the matching key state table entry, then loops with no exit.

name: mark_table_entry_pressed
description: Sets one byte of a table, indexed by the masked input value, to 255, and then loops with no exit.

name: stub_infinite_loop_handler
description: Its decoded body only loops forever with no exit, so it performs no work of its own.

name: spin_after_raster_wait
description: Its decoded body is an infinite loop with no exit. The raster position register it touches suggests a wait on the display beam, but that wait is not visible in the decoded body.

name: enable_serial_interrupt
description: Clears one bit of the serial control register and writes the interrupt enable register with the serial interrupt enabled.

name: read_joystick_direction_state
description: Reads the mouse and joystick port movement registers and the fire-button port, decodes the movement bits into direction flags, and calls a registered callback when one is set.

name: take_and_clear_global
description: Returns the current value of a global word and resets the global to zero.

name: merge_key_state_tables
description: Merges 128 bytes of key state into a second table and a third table with bitwise operations, updating the copies as it goes.

name: clear_three_state_tables
description: Zeroes 32 longwords in each of three tables that start at fixed addresses.

name: set_interrupt_flag_bit_seven
description: Stores the single-bit value for bit seven into the interrupt request global, marking that interrupt as pending.

name: set_interrupt_flag_bit_eight
description: Stores the single-bit value for bit eight into the interrupt request global, marking that interrupt as pending.

name: set_interrupt_flag_bit_nine
description: Stores the single-bit value for bit nine into the interrupt request global, marking that interrupt as pending.

name: set_interrupt_flag_bit_ten
description: Stores the single-bit value for bit ten into the interrupt request global, marking that interrupt as pending.

name: init_audio_channel_three
description: Initializes the state fields of audio channel three, setting its period, volume and interrupt request bit, and stores a pointer to its channel data.

name: dispatch_pending_interrupt_bits
description: Checks interrupt request bits seven through ten, calls the matching handler for each pending bit, and then writes the interrupt enable register with the enable bit set.

name: initialize_all_audio_channels
description: Initializes the state of all four audio channels, setting period, volume and handler fields, waits for a raster line, and then enables the DMA and interrupt bits for the channels.

name: schedule_delayed_callback
description: Stores a timed callback request. When the requested delay is zero it uses a default of 5000, fills a request record and sets the interrupt enable bit for it.

name: queue_interrupt_handler_request
description: Stores a handler address and its arguments in a request record, then writes the control words that schedule it. It uses a second handler when the flag argument is set.

name: start_audio_channel_zero_sample
description: Starts playback on audio channel zero by setting its sample pointer, length, period and volume, waiting for a raster line, and then enabling its DMA and interrupt bits.

name: start_audio_channel_one_sample
description: Starts playback on audio channel one by setting its sample pointer, length, period and volume, waiting for a raster line, and then enabling its DMA and interrupt bits.

name: start_audio_channel_two_sample
description: Starts playback on audio channel two by setting its sample pointer, length, period and volume, waiting for a raster line, and then enabling its DMA and interrupt bits.

name: start_audio_channel_three_sample
description: Starts playback on audio channel three by setting its sample pointer, length, period and volume, waiting for a raster line, and then enabling its DMA and interrupt bits.

name: build_free_node_chain
description: Links nineteen fixed-size nodes spaced 118 bytes apart into a chain, terminates the last one, and sets the list head to empty.

name: tick_timer_list_entries
description: Walks a list of timer entries, decrementing each entry's count and returning the stored data of the first entry whose count reaches zero. It returns the list head value when no entry expires.

name: store_request_registers_in_record
description: Copies seven register-passed values into a request record and marks the record as active.

name: poll_timer_list_for_expiry
description: Walks a list of timer entries, decrementing their counts until one reaches zero, and returns that entry's stored value, or the list head value when none expire.

name: find_flagged_list_entry
description: Walks a linked list and stops at the first entry whose flag byte is set or that matches the current entry. It returns the input value when the end of the list is reached.

name: insert_node_into_list
description: Inserts a node into a linked list at the position where the search pointer stops, then decrements a counter kept in the list head.

name: clear_and_release_node
description: Clears the contents of a node byte by byte and then returns it to the free list.

name: xor_fold_longword_table
description: XOR-accumulates a table of 32-bit words into one running value and returns that value masked with an alternating bit pattern.

name: xor_fold_longword_table
description: XOR-accumulates a table of 32-bit words into one running value and returns that value masked with an alternating bit pattern.

name: xor_fold_longword_table
description: XOR-accumulates a table of 32-bit words into one running value and returns that value masked with an alternating bit pattern.

name: xor_fold_longword_table
description: XOR-accumulates a table of 32-bit words into one running value and returns that value masked with an alternating bit pattern.

name: xor_fold_longword_table
description: XOR-accumulates a table of 32-bit words into one running value and returns that value masked with an alternating bit pattern.

name: xor_fold_longword_table
description: XOR-accumulates a table of 32-bit words into one running value and returns that value masked with an alternating bit pattern.

name: xor_fold_longword_table
description: XOR-accumulates a table of 32-bit words into one running value and returns that value masked with an alternating bit pattern.

name: call_three_routines_pass_input
description: Calls three shared routines in sequence and returns the input register unchanged.

name: store_masked_bitplane_word
description: Builds a word from the alternating bit pattern of the input and its shifted neighbours, clears the top bit when a flag byte before the target is set, and stores the result through the pointer.

name: update_sprite_flag_bit
description: Clears the top bit of a byte when the byte before it has its low bit set. Otherwise it sets the top bit, unless bit six is already set.

name: store_low_seven_bits
description: Stores the low seven bits of the input byte through the pointer.

name: write_mfm_sync_marks
description: Stores the standard disk sync word pattern twice in a record, then runs a sequence of routine calls that writes the track sync data.

name: call_four_shared_routines
description: Calls four shared routines in sequence and returns.

name: start_blitter_fill_rectangle
description: Waits for the blitter to be free, programs its first and last word masks, modulo values, pointers and size, and starts a blit that uses a fill pattern value.

name: interleave_two_bitplane_words
description: Combines two longwords by taking the alternating bit pattern from each, with the second supplying the odd bits and the first, shifted left one bit, supplying the even bits. It returns the combined value.

name: call_shared_routine_pass_input
description: Calls one shared routine and returns the input register unchanged.

name: start_blitter_copy_rectangle
description: Waits for the blitter, programs its masks, modulo values, pointers and size from an image record, and starts a copy blit for the rectangle.

name: set_timing_mode_zero
description: Sets the mode global to zero and stores the timing value 48 in a second global.

name: set_timing_mode_one
description: Sets the mode global to one and stores the timing value 40 in a second global.

name: set_timing_mode_two
description: Sets the mode global to two and stores the timing value 24 in a second global.

name: pulse_drive_control_port
description: Sets a control flag to zero, writes a control pattern to the second CIA port B register, and then calls a shared routine 250 times to pause.

name: release_drive_control_port
description: Writes the value 255 to the second CIA port B register, which releases the drive control lines.

name: load_cia_timer_values
description: Updates a control word, loads a timer value of 100 and sets the interrupt mask on the CIA timer registers.

name: step_drive_head_to_track
description: Moves a head position counter one track at a time toward the target track, calling a shared routine for each step, and returns when the positions match.

name: select_drive_and_reset_control
description: Sets the drive-select bits on the second CIA port, selects motor state from a flag, and resets the control word and timer values.

name: select_drive_port_and_call
description: Sets the drive-select bits on the second CIA port and calls one shared routine.

name: select_drive_port_and_call
description: Sets the drive-select bits on the second CIA port and calls one shared routine.

name: wait_for_port_bit_release
description: Calls a shared routine repeatedly while bit four of the fire-button port stays set, and clears a counter when the bit is released.

name: split_block_to_track_sector
description: Divides a block number by eleven, the sector count per track on an Amiga disk, and stores the side bit, cylinder and sector remainder in three globals.

name: fill_gap_and_write_sector
description: Fills a block of 1086 bytes with the alternating byte pattern used for track gaps, then builds a sector header and calls a shared routine for the sector data.

name: start_disk_dma_transfer
description: Waits for the disk interrupt flag, then programs the disk DMA pointer and length registers with a fixed transfer size, enables the disk DMA and interrupt bits, and calls a shared routine.

name: check_drive_status_bits
description: Checks two status bits of the drive port. When the first bit is set it stores an error code of minus eight, when the second bit is clear it stores minus five, and otherwise it calls a shared routine.

name: check_drive_ready_bit
description: Stores an error code of minus five when a drive status bit is clear, and otherwise calls a shared routine.

name: call_shared_routine_only
description: Calls one shared routine and returns the register pair it leaves.

name: prepare_disk_sync_read
description: Returns an error code of minus eight when the drive status bit is set. Otherwise it stores the disk sync word, the DMA length and the control words in a record and starts the disk transfer.

name: stop_disk_dma_and_reset
description: Enables the disk DMA control bit, sets a sector counter to minus one, calls a shared routine twelve times, and then clears the related state fields.

name: scan_track_for_sync_word
description: Scans a track buffer for the disk sync word and decodes each sector header it finds through a shared routine. It stops at the first header whose sector number lies within the eleven sectors of a track.

name: clear_track_buffers
description: Fills a 2000-longword buffer with minus one and then clears a second buffer of 2000 longwords with zeros, calling a shared routine when the flag is set.

name: fill_marker_and_decode_track
description: Fills 1400 longwords with a fixed four-byte marker, then calls a sequence of shared routines that decode track data until a flag is set.

name: call_two_routines_return_status
description: Calls two shared routines and returns the stored status value.

name: call_two_routines_return_status
description: Calls two shared routines and returns the stored status value.

name: retry_drive_operation
description: Stores a step value, then calls shared routines in a series of retry steps, returning early when a step succeeds.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Its decoded body is empty, so it does nothing.

name: check_retry_flags_set_status
description: Runs a sequence of flag checks with shared routine calls between them. It sets the status to minus one when the final check fails, and otherwise returns with the status unchanged.

name: retry_track_read_loop
description: Starts a retry counter at twenty, then repeatedly sets up a step value of forty and calls shared routines until one succeeds or the status reaches minus eight.

name: seek_and_read_track_sectors
description: Copies the start track and destination pointer from the inputs, then loops over shared routines that seek and read sectors until none remain.

name: halt_after_one_call
description: Calls one shared routine and then loops forever with no exit. The background colour and interrupt enable registers it touches do not appear in the decoded body.

name: copy_track_block_to_buffer
description: Copies 128 longwords from a track buffer selected by a track index into the destination pointer, then sets the status to zero.

name: clear_record_list_flags
description: Walks a table of eight-longword records until the sentinel value, zeroing three fields and clearing the top bit of each record's flag byte, then sets a state word.

name: clear_record_flag_bits
description: Walks the same eight-longword record table until the sentinel value, clearing the top bit of each flag byte and zeroing one field, then sets a state word.
